system.description: You can call on the spirits of dead animals to aid you. These spirits are predisposed to helping you and can follow simple telepathic commands, taking any action of which they were capable in normal life (e.g., a bird spirit can fly, a dog spirit has keen hearing, etc.). Generally it takes one Mental Trait to summon a spirit, though a Narrator may issue a higher cost for a larger, more powerful spirit. The spirit arrives in 10-30 minutes and is invisible except to those who can see into the spirit world. It aids you for one night, then returns to the land of the dead. (This power is listed as an additional Basic-level Spiritus power in this supplement.)
